issues.message: "invariants.continuation_required" is declared but not enforced in v1 — the engine records it without acting on it. Keep it for forward-compatibility or remove it; it changes nothing today.

"invariants.preserve_lineage" is declared but not enforced in v1 — the engine records it without acting on it (lineage IS always preserved via chain_of_record; the flag itself gates nothing). Keep it for forward-compatibility or remove it; it changes nothing today.

"invariants.closure_required" is declared but not enforced in v1 — the engine records it without acting on it (closure IS always required by the hot-potato contract; the flag itself gates nothing). Keep it for forward-compatibility or remove it; it changes nothing today.

"closure.{success,degraded,failed}" is declared but not enforced in v1 — the engine records it without acting on it (display-only messages; no consumer renders them yet). Keep it for forward-compatibility or remove it; it changes nothing today.

"loop_guards.spawn_budget" is declared but not enforced in v1 — the engine records it without acting on it (it guards a SPAWN mechanism and no spawn/fan-out seam exists in the single-frontier model; enforcement is a NAMED acceptance item of the WF-2/WF-6 parallel-frontier fan-out work (arch ruling 2026-07-06)). Keep it for forward-compatibility or remove it; it changes nothing today.
